findings.message: This adds `airflow.providers.common.ai.toolsets.managed_agent` to the `toolsets` list in `provider.yaml`, but the diff carries no matching change to `providers/common/ai/src/airflow/providers/common/ai/get_provider_info.py`. Run `prek run update-providers-build-files` and commit the regenerated `get_provider_info.py` alongside this edit, or the pre-commit consistency check fails and the new toolset module is missing from the packaged provider metadata.
